name: d0cgxn-due-launch-gate
goal: Keep scheduled work out of unattended launch until the due time, then launch it through normal dispatch

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Runs 1263 and 1264 started automatically about two hours after schedule-on, ahead of their stored due timestamps.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Tracker due-launch coverage only ticked the scheduler. It now enables the schedule and sweeps idle work before due; dispatcher coverage rechecks queued automatic claims and recovery.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
